speaker: A
name: Mia
text: [curious] Have you ever bought shoes online?

speaker: B
name: Ethan
text: [relaxed] Yes, of course. I haven't bought any shoes offline since junior high school. I always buy shoes online, because I have plenty of choices there, and I can just pick whatever I want. [emphasis] I can also watch some recommendations from bloggers, and then go straight to the shopping website and buy the same shoes they recommend.
